# Reverend Jo

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009)</sub>
- **Origin:** St. Columbia  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009)</sub>
- **Role:** minister  <sub>[v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029)</sub>
- **Titles:** Rev.  <sub>[v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)</sub>; Reverend  <sub>[v4 c3 P9](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0009), [v4 c3 P43](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0043)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Jonas  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c25 P12](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0012)</sub>; Jo  <sub>[v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021), [v3 c38 P5](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0005)</sub>

## Appearance

Jonas is described as a very plain and ugly young man with a big, loose-jointed figure and absurdly long legs. He has lank, tow-colored hair, green eyes, a large mouth, and prominent ears. When radiant with happiness, people hardly consider him plain.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c24 P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)_

## Personality

Jonas has a warm, genial demeanor that exudes niceness. He enjoys laughing, joking, and lighthearted society, making him a popular companion among younger friends, though some older ladies disapprove of his informal manner.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c25 P12](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0012)_

## Abilities

- delivering eloquent prayers  <sub>[v4 c4 P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016)</sub>

## Goals

- to fulfill his duty as a minister in the work given to him by God  <sub>[v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019)</sub>
- to serve in a mission church in the Patterson Street slums  <sub>[v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029)</sub>

## History

Jonas Blake attended Redmond College before studying divinity at St. Columbia. During a summer break, he took charge of the Point Prospect Mission Church, where he met Philippa Gordon and quickly became close companions with her. After a period of courtship, Jonas proposed to Philippa, who accepted him despite initial opposition from her mother. Upon graduating from St. Columbia, he took up work at a mission church on Patterson Street in the slums. Jonas married Philippa in June following his graduation. Later, the couple visited Green Gables, where Jonas offered a memorable prayer during Anne Shirley's wedding ceremony.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029), [v3 c35 P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039), [v4 c3 P43](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0043), [v4 c4 P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016)_

## Background by volume

- graduated from Redmond College  <sub>[v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012)</sub>
- resisted becoming a minister for a long time before accepting it as his calling  <sub>[v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019)</sub>
- took charge of the Point Prospect Mission Church during one summer  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009)</sub>
- studied theology at St. Columbia  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029)</sub>

## Quotes

> No, I couldn’t. I tried to be something else for a long time—I didn’t want to be a minister. But I came to see at last that it was the work given me to do—and God helping me, I shall try to do it.  <sub>[v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019)</sub>
